faqs.q: What are Bijur Delimon lubrication system enclosures used for?
faqs.a: They house and protect lubrication pumps, controls and electrics against dust, dirt, oil, water and other contaminants. They are supplied with subpanels and the system mounted inside, for outdoor and washdown installations, mining and cement plant, and plug-and-play lubrication systems.

faqs.q: How do I read an enclosure part number such as 36529 — ENCLOSURE WITH WINDOW 30X24X12?
faqs.a: The item text gives the type and the size in inches: 36529 is an enclosure with window, 30 x 24 x 12 in. Subpanels have their own numbers, for example 36531 is the subpanel 28.2 x 22.2 in for the 30 x 24 enclosures.

faqs.q: What sizes do Bijur Delimon lubrication enclosures come in?
faqs.a: Enclosures run from 16 x 16 x 10 in to 72 x 37 x 30 in across 51 listed part numbers, with and without windows. Other listed sizes include 24 x 24 x 16.5, 30 x 24 x 12, 36 x 24 x 12, 48 x 36 x 16 and 60 x 36 x 12 in.

faqs.q: Which NEMA types are listed for the lubrication enclosures?
faqs.a: NEMA 4 and 4X enclosures are listed, such as 35781 (NEMA 4X, 24 x 24 x 16.5 in) and 37343 (NEMA 4, 72 x 37 x 30 in). NEMA 12 and 12/13 types are also listed, for example 37801 at 48 x 30 x 10 in. Tell us the rating your site needs.

faqs.q: Is there a stainless steel Bijur Delimon lubrication enclosure?
faqs.a: Yes. Part 85371 is listed as a 62 x 48 x 12 in stainless steel (SS) enclosure. Other enclosures are listed by NEMA type and size, so state the material you need on the enquiry.

faqs.q: What subpanels, backplates and windows go with the enclosures?
faqs.a: Subpanels and backplates are listed per enclosure size: 36523 is a 14.2 x 14.2 in subpanel, 35782 a 21 x 21 in backplate and 37235 a 14 x 12 in sub plate used with enclosure 37234. Part 39764 is a 5 x 3 in window kit.

faqs.q: Is there a heater for a Bijur Delimon lubrication enclosure on a cold site?
faqs.a: Yes. Part 85190 is a heater unit for enclosures, rated 115 VAC and 1,300 W, for cold sites. Check the supply voltage at your site before ordering.

faqs.q: Lubrication system enclosure compared with the RetrievAll oil recovery systems: what is the difference?
faqs.a: An enclosure houses pumps and controls and protects them from the environment. The [RetrievAll oil leak recovery systems](/p/bijur-delimon-retrievall-oil-leak-recovery-systems) collect leaked hydraulic oil from machine points. Pick the enclosure for the electrics and the RetrievAll for leaks.

faqs.q: Where are lubrication system enclosures used?
faqs.a: They suit outdoor and washdown installations, mining and cement plant, and complete plug-and-play lubrication systems. See the [Lubrication Enclosures and Oil Recovery shelf](/c/lubrication-enclosures-oil-recovery).

faqs.q: Where do I find the datasheet for Bijur Delimon enclosures?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon Enclosures Datasheet is in the Downloads tab for this range. Send us the part number if you need a drawing or the mounting details for a specific size.

faqs.q: How should I choose a lubrication enclosure for my site?
faqs.a: Choose on the components it must house, the environment (dust, washdown, outdoor heat or cold) and the NEMA or IP rating needed. Tell us the pump, controller and lubrication points and we propose the enclosure size, subpanel and any heater.

faqs.q: Do you keep the Bijur Delimon lubrication system enclosures in stock, and how do I get a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes, the Bijur Delimon lubrication system enclosures is held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and ships worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the part numbers and quantities via [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the Bijur Delimon RetrievAll oil leak recovery system?
faqs.a: RetrievAll collects hydraulic oil that leaks from machine components and returns it for recycling. Collection tubes at each leak point run to a small central reservoir under air-powered vacuum. It suits presses, injection-moulding machines and hydraulic machinery with chronic leaks.

faqs.q: How do I read RetrievAll items such as 2090199 — FLUID RECOVERY 24VDC 4-INLETS CHECK VALVE?
faqs.a: The text gives the function, the control voltage and the number of inlets: 2090199 is a fluid recovery unit, 24 VDC, with four inlets and a check valve, and 37385 is the same unit with a filter. The remaining part numbers are service parts.

faqs.q: How does the RetrievAll system work step by step?
faqs.a: Collection tubes at each leak point run to a small central reservoir under air-powered vacuum. When the reservoir fills, a level switch triggers a blow-down that pushes the oil out through a single line to a collection point.

faqs.q: What are the electrical and connection data of the RetrievAll units?
faqs.a: The two complete units are 24 VDC with four inlets, with a low-level switch. Connections are oil in 1/8 NPT and air in 1/4 NPT, and the outlet thread is 1/4 NPT. The body material is brass.

faqs.q: Which fluid does the RetrievAll recover?
faqs.a: It recovers hydraulic oil. The listing is for oil only, so confirm the fluid and its viscosity with us if you have a different leak.

faqs.q: What service parts are listed for the RetrievAll system?
faqs.a: Parts include the vacuum generator (27296), solenoid valves 27299 and 27300 (24 VDC), level switch 27603, check valve 27698, orifice basket 27310 (2.4 mm), reservoir gasket 31987, a 37384 coalescing filter element (0.5 micron), mufflers and breathers. Send us the unit part number and the part you need.

faqs.q: What does the 0.5 micron coalescing element do in the RetrievAll system?
faqs.a: Part 37384 is the coalescing filter element, rated 0.5 micron, for the oil line of the unit. Fit the element listed for your unit and replace it with the service parts supplied by Bijur Delimon.

faqs.q: RetrievAll compared with a lubrication system enclosure: which one do I need?
faqs.a: RetrievAll recovers leaked oil from several leak points to one collection point. A [lubrication system enclosure](/p/bijur-delimon-lubrication-system-enclosures) protects pumps and controls. They are often used together on washdown sites.

faqs.q: Where is RetrievAll used?
faqs.a: Typical uses are presses and injection-moulding machines and hydraulic machinery with chronic leaks. See the [Lubrication Enclosures and Oil Recovery shelf](/c/lubrication-enclosures-oil-recovery) for other products in this group.

faqs.q: Where do I find the RetrievAll datasheet?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon RetrievAll document is in the Downloads tab for this range. Send us the part number if you need a drawing or the connection details for a specific unit.

faqs.q: How do I size a RetrievAll system for my machine?
faqs.a: Size it on the number of leak points and the distance to the collection point. Send the machine and a list of the leak points and we propose the units, tubing and fittings.

faqs.q: Do you keep the Bijur Delimon RetrievAll oil leak recovery system in stock, and how do I get a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes. The Bijur Delimon RetrievAll oil leak recovery system is in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, with worldwide shipping at the best lead times. Request a quote by sending what you need through [our contact page](/contact).
